# map_visited.bin (WorldMapVisited), see tests/original_probe/VisitedProbe.java for the commands
# the player's real file (the current format; the grid is -250..250), then with the whole map known
open real
dump
mapallknown 1
open real
mapallknown 0
open none
dump
# the setters and clearers: overlaps, empty and one-unit regions, squares outside the grid, int overflow
setVisitedSquares 8200 11600 8400 11800
setKnownSquares 8000 11000 9000 12000
dump
clearVisitedSquares 8250 11650 8300 11700
clearKnownSquares 8100 11100 8200 11200
dump
setVisitedSquares 10 10 10 20
setVisitedSquares 10 10 20 10
setVisitedSquares 5 5 6 6
setVisitedSquares 0 0 33 33
setKnownSquares 100 100 132 132
setKnownSquares 100 100 131 131
dump
setKnownSquares 2147483647 2147483647 -2147483648 -2147483648
setVisitedSquares -2147483648 -2147483648 2147483647 2147483647
setVisitedSquares -100000 -100000 -90000 -90000
setKnownSquares 90000 90000 100000 100000
dump
setKnownCells 0 0 3 3
setVisitedCells -2 -2 2 2
clearKnownCells 1 1 2 2
clearVisitedCells -1 -1 0 0
setKnownCells 249 249 250 250
setVisitedCells -250 -250 -249 -249
dump
save
open keep
dump
# round trips: the saved file read back, then cleared back to nothing
clearKnownCells -250 -250 250 250
clearVisitedCells -251 -251 251 251
dump
save
open keep
dump
# the whole map visited and known, saved, read back with MapAllKnown on
setVisitedCells -250 -250 251 251
setKnownCells -250 -250 250 250
dump
save
mapallknown 1
open keep
mapallknown 0
dump
# the current format cut short and too long: a short body copies what it has, none or too much throws
openbody 0 00
openbody 0 01020304ff80
openbody -100 0102030405
openbody -4016016 01
openbody 10 01
openbody 1 ff
openbody -1 03
